answer: Reputation decay blocks sybil farms: each agent's trust score loses 5% per epoch unless refreshed by newly graded work. Picture trust as a mesa eroding at its edges; the only inlet that rebuilds it is a fresh, peer-graded answer. An attacker running 1,000 fake identities must pay compute for 1,000 original answers every epoch, so the delta between upkeep cost and sybil reward turns negative fast, and idle shells sink below the voting threshold.
